detail.description: The S3 bucket prod-billing-exports has a bucket policy granting s3:GetObject to the public (Principal: *). Any unauthenticated user on the internet can download billing export files containing PII and financial records.
detail.recommendation: Remove the public-access bucket policy, enable S3 Block Public Access at bucket level, and audit CloudTrail for any prior unauthorised reads.
mitre: T1530 – Data from Cloud Storage Object

detail.description: Cloud SQL instance prod-db is configured with a public IP address and SSL enforcement is disabled. Database credentials transmitted in plaintext are at risk of interception.
detail.recommendation: Disable public IP, configure a private IP within the VPC, enable requireSSL, and restrict authorised networks to known CIDR ranges only.

detail.description: Service account dev-admin has the Owner role at project level but only 12% of granted permissions are exercised. This violates the principle of least privilege and creates a large blast radius if the account is compromised.
detail.recommendation: Audit actual permissions used via Policy Analyzer, downscope to a custom role with only required permissions, and rotate the service account key.

detail.description: Azure Storage account acme-prod has Allow Blob Public Access enabled, permitting anonymous reads on all blob containers within the account.
detail.recommendation: Set AllowBlobPublicAccess to false at the storage account level and review individual container ACLs to remove any anonymous-read configurations.
mitre: T1530 – Data from Cloud Storage Object

detail.description: Security group sg-0a1b2c allows unrestricted inbound SSH access (port 22) from 0.0.0.0/0 and ::/0. Brute-force and credential stuffing attacks are actively observed against this IP range.
detail.recommendation: Restrict inbound SSH to the corporate VPN CIDR only, or replace direct SSH with AWS Systems Manager Session Manager and remove port 22 entirely.

detail.description: AWS CloudTrail is not enabled in the us-east-1 region. All API activity in this region is unrecorded, preventing incident investigation and compliance auditing.
detail.recommendation: Enable a multi-region CloudTrail trail with S3 log file validation, and configure CloudWatch Logs integration for real-time alerting on suspicious API calls.

detail.description: Lambda function data-exporter has an execution role with Action: * Resource: * — full administrator privileges. If the function is compromised, the attacker inherits full AWS account access.
detail.recommendation: Create a least-privilege IAM role granting only s3:PutObject on the target bucket and replace the current wildcard role.

detail.description: Kubernetes Dashboard is exposed on a public LoadBalancer IP with no authentication configured. This provides a web UI with full cluster control to any unauthenticated user.
detail.recommendation: Delete the Dashboard service or change service type to ClusterIP. Access the dashboard only via kubectl proxy over an authenticated session.

detail.description: Azure Key Vault kv-prod has soft-delete and purge protection disabled. Accidental or malicious deletion of secrets would be permanent and unrecoverable.
detail.recommendation: Enable soft-delete (90-day retention) and purge protection on the Key Vault. These settings cannot be disabled once enabled — plan before applying.

detail.description: RDS instance finance-db-prod has automated backups disabled and Multi-AZ is not configured. A hardware failure or ransomware event would result in permanent data loss for finance records.
detail.recommendation: Enable automated backups with at least 7-day retention, enable Multi-AZ for high availability, and test restoration procedures quarterly.
